newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Coelba still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Coelba still a hold.

text.p: Robert Fleming & Co Ltd said it has maintained its hold recommendation on Brazilian electrical distributor Coelba after its privatization last week.

-- Flemings analyst Walter Stoeppelwerth said the rating was "based on our expectations for a nine-month lag until the company's quarterly results begin delivering numbers that justify outperformance."
--- On Thursday, a consortium made up of Spain's Iberdrola and a group of Banco do Brasil funds won bidding on a 65.34-percent voting stake in Coelba with an offer of 1.73 billion reais.
-- "This 77 percent premium to the minimum price surprised the market, which was expecting a 35 percent to 40 percent premium," Stoeppelwerth wrote.
-- But the price was just 3.78 percent above power firm Light's intended bid and 6.8 percent above that of a Chilean-led consortium, he added.
-- Coelba common was off 4.35 percent at 99 reais at 1503 local/1603 GMT on the Sao Paulo bolsa. Its preferred share was untraded at its Monday close of 92.80 reais.
